(2013, 2016) and related studies of peer-reviewed abstracts found that among papers taking a position, about 97% endorsed anthropogenic global warming; later surveys of publishing climate scientists find similarly high agreement. The greenhouse effect of CO2 is established physics; isotopic and inventory data show that the industrial-era CO2 rise is from fossil carbon. Claims that 'there is no consensus' or that a petition of non-climate specialists overturns IPCC assessments misrepresent how scientific agreement is established. A 2019 'European Climate Declaration' signed by hundreds of people, including many without climate-research credentials, does not negate the assessed literature. Uncertainty remains about the exact magnitude of climate sensitivity and regional impacts, not about whether adding CO2 warms the planet.
